'''Ōtsu Shrine''' (大津神社) refers to several Shinto shrines in Japan:

* {{ill|Ōtsu Shrine (Hida)|ja|大津神社 (飛騨市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtsu Shrine (Hida)|qq=}} - Located in Hida City, Gifu Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtsu Shrine (Ise)|ja|大津神社 (伊勢市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtsu Shrine (Ise)|qq=}} - Located in Ise City, Mie Prefecture. A subsidiary shrine of {{ill|Tōyūke Daijingū|ja|豊受大神宮|1=Toyōke Daijingū|2=ja|3=豊受大神宮|4=zh|5=豐受大神宮|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tōyūke Daijingū|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyōke Daijingū|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}, part of the 125 shrines of the {{ill|Ise Shrine|en|Ise Shrine|qid=Q687168|lt=Ise Grand Shrine|1=Ise Grand Shrine}}.
* {{ill|Ōtsu Shrine (Izumi Ōtsu)|ja|大津神社 (泉大津市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtsu Shrine (Izumi Ōtsu)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Izumi Ōtsu City, Osaka Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtsu Shrine (Habikino)|ja|大津神社 (羽曳野市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtsu Shrine (Habikino)|qq=}} - Located in Habikino City, Osaka Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtsu Shrine (Higashi Ōsaka)|ja|大津神社 (東大阪市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtsu Shrine (Higashi Ōsaka)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Higashi Ōsaka City, Osaka Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtsu Shrine (Nishiwaki)|ja|大津神社 (西脇市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtsu Shrine (Nishiwaki)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Nishiwaki City, Hyōgo Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtsu Shrine (Maniwa)|ja|大津神社 (真庭市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtsu Shrine (Maniwa)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Maniwa City, Okayama Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtsu Shrine (Ōita)|ja|大津神社 (大分市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtsu Shrine (Ōita)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Ōita City, Ōita Prefecture.
